s: Run to warm the oil; park safe & level; key out
Drain pan under drain plug Ⓐ (underside of engine); remove plug
Wipe around oil filter Ⓑ; turn CCW to remove
Light coat of clean oil on new filter gasket; install CW until gasket contacts + ½ turn
Install drain plug (don't overtighten); fill via cap to dipstick range — 5.3 L (5.6 qt) Plus-50 II — don't overfill
Run, check leaks, recheck level
Level ground, implements down, relieve pressure
Drain case (~47.3 L / 12.5 gal)
Replace filter, clean magnetic plug
Refill ~12.5 gal Hy-Gard J20D/J20C
Cycle hydraulics, recheck, check leaks
Engine off & cool; move fuel shutoff valve Ⓐ to CLOSED Ⓑ
Drain pan under sediment bowl Ⓒ; wipe; turn bowl CCW to remove; clean
Discard old fuel filter Ⓓ; fit new filter to head; refit sediment bowl
Replace primary (water-separator) + final filter (CW until gasket contacts + ½ turn)
Open fuel valve; key ON 10–15 s to self-bleed; start, idle, check leaks
Open air cleaner; release hold-down strap Ⓐ
Remove primary element; clean or replace per the restriction indicator
Inspect the secondary/safety element — replace, never clean it
Check the air-intake hose for cracks/looseness
Reseat elements; cover latched and sealed
Grease all lube points per the manual diagram
Check front axle oil level
Clean or replace the cab air filter
Check ROPS & front-hitch hardware torque
Wipe fittings; note any worn zerks

jobs.t: Air Filter · Spark Plugs · Fuel Filter — 100 hr (OMM174377 p.47–48)
s: Cool engine, key out. Lift out foam pre-cleaner (D) + paper element (E); replace paper if dirty (never wash it)
Clean air-cleaner base (F) carefully — no dirt into intake tube (G); do NOT oil the foam pre-cleaner
Reinstall onto intake tube (G); align clamp; cover thumbscrews (A) ¼ turn CW
Spark plugs: pull wire (A) each side, remove, wire-brush; gap (B) 0.75 mm (0.030 in)
Install plugs, torque 15 N·m (11 lb-ft) per procedure (Specs table shows 20 N·m — confirm); reconnect wires
Fuel filter: slide hose clamps off, swap paper filter same flow direction, check for leaks

jobs.t: Mower Deck · Blades · Grease — seasonal / 50 hr (OMM174377 p.39–40)

Grease 3 spindle zerks (B) + idler arm pivot (C) + front axle pivot — 2 pumps JD HD Lithium (p.40)
Remove 3 blades (note sail dir); sharpen to bevel, balance each; replace if cracked
Check spindles + belt; scrape deck underside
Reinstall blades, torque 68 N·m (50 lb-ft); rear wheel bolt 84 N·m (62 lb-ft) if pulled

DAILY: clean saw; check throttle lock & chain brake; turn bar, clean groove & oiler hole; check chain & sprocket; sharpen; tight nuts/screws; no fuel leaks
WEEKLY: check cooling system, starter cord & return spring, vibration dampers; deburr bar; clean spark-arrestor screen; clean carb compartment
MONTHLY: check brake band (replace <0.024"/0.6mm), clutch centre/drum/spring; clean spark plug; check fuel hose & filter; empty & clean fuel + oil tanks; check cables

Reinstall (cutters forward), tension, top bar oil
Storage: empty fuel & oil tanks, run carb dry; coat bar in oil; relieve tension; bar guard on

Clean around & remove oil fill cap/dipstick; drain pan under crankcase
Unscrew oil drain bolt (1) — do NOT touch the cam-chain push-rod bolt (3)
Tilt side to side to finish draining
Fit a NEW sealing washer; install drain bolt → 24 N·m (18 lbf·ft)
Refill ~1.0 L 10W-30 JASO MA; idle 3–5 min; check level to upper mark
Check for leaks; dispose of used oil properly
Engine COLD. Remove head cover (bolts+mount rubbers) & gasket
Remove crankshaft & timing hole caps (O-rings)
Rotate flywheel CCW until T mark (8) aligns with index mark (9)
Confirm TDC compression — rockers free (both valves closed); if tight rotate 360°
Feeler-gauge each valve: Intake 0.10±0.02 · Exhaust 0.15±0.02 mm
Adjust: loosen lock nut (12), set slight drag, retighten while holding screw; recheck
Oil new O-rings; refit caps, new head-cover gasket (mount rubbers UP-mark out)
Remove bolts (1) & housing cover (2); remove air cleaner (3)
Wash gently in high-flash solvent (kerosene) — NOT gasoline; squeeze, don't wring
Inspect foam for tears — replace if damaged; dry THOROUGHLY
Work in Pro Honda Foam Filter Oil evenly; squeeze out excess
Clean housing; refit aligning hole (4) to boss (5); refit cover
Plug: clean base, remove; inspect electrodes/insulator
Gap to 0.8–0.9 mm (NGK CPR6EA-9S); reinstall, don't over-torque alloy head
Chain: slack 10–20 mm; inspect rollers/pins/sprockets
Clean & lube with Pro Honda HP Chain Lube; confirm axle alignment marks
Engine oil to upper mark
Chain slack 10–20 mm, lubed; tires 15 psi F&R
Brakes firm; throttle snaps closed; kill switch works
Throttle limiter set for rider; fuel fresh, cap secure
Helmet + PPE every rider, every ride

Remove screw plug ③ (O-ring) — do NOT remove screw ④; drain fully; clean screens & sealing surfaces
Refit plug ③ with NEW O-ring → torque 15 Nm (M20×1.5)
Push oil screen ⑤ fully home; refit plug ① with O-ring → 15 Nm
Refit magnetic drain plug ② with NEW seal ring → 20 Nm (M12×1.5)

Refit cover → screws 10 Nm (M6); stand upright; remove filler plug ⑨; add 1.0 L 10W/50 full synthetic
Refit filler plug; run briefly; check sight glass (engine off, wait 1 min); top up if below lower edge; refit skid plate
Remove air filter box cover (pull at area A, push forward)
Detach tab ①; remove the air filter with its support
Wash the filter in cleaner and dry fully — never run the engine without a filter
Grease the sealing edge (area A) with long-life grease
Mount filter on support; seat retaining pin in bushing; secure with the holding tab
Refit the air-box cover. Clean every dusty ride
On lift stand: rinse loose dirt (gentle jet); remove old grease with chain cleaner; dry
Apply off-road chain spray; wipe excess — keep off tires & brake discs
Check tension at the lower run: target 58–61 mm; measure at several spots (uneven wear)
If out of spec: loosen axle, turn adjusters EQUALLY (watch alignment marks), reset 58–61 mm, torque axle
Inspect chain, rear + front sprocket and chain guide for wear; replace as a set if worn

If out of spec → shim adjustment (workshop job); refit cover w/ gasket, torque, check leaks
